description: This file defines data structures and parsing logic for handling deep links within the application. It includes enumerations, structs, and a parser for 'openclaw' scheme URLs, supporting 'agent' and 'gateway' link types with associated parameters.

classes.name: GatewayConnectDeepLink
classes.description: Represents connection details for a gateway, including host, port, TLS, and optional authentication tokens.

classes.name: AgentDeepLink
classes.description: Defines a deep link for agent-related actions, including message, session info, and delivery preferences.

methods.name: fromSetupCode
methods.description: Parses a base64url-encoded JSON setup code to extract connection parameters for GatewayConnectDeepLink.

methods.name: decodeBase64Url
methods.description: Decodes a base64url-encoded string into Data.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a URL with the 'openclaw' scheme into a DeepLinkRoute, handling 'agent' and 'gateway' hosts.
